# fixed13 RFC3161 golden vector

Committed, public-only fixture used by `fixed13_crypto_runtime.py`'s
production-profile capability self-test (`BIGLOTTO_FIXED13_CRYPTO_RUNTIME_CANONICALIZATION_R1`).

It exists to distinguish a genuinely capable OpenSSL >=3 `ts -verify` backend
from one (e.g. the macOS system `/usr/bin/openssl`, which is actually
LibreSSL) that cannot correctly verify the certificate/attribute profile
fixed-13 production receipts use. No fixture in this directory contains
private key material; every private key used to generate these files was
created in a throwaway system-temp directory and deleted immediately after
generation.

## Profile

- Chain: root CA -> intermediate CA -> TSA leaf (3 tiers).
- TSA leaf: `extendedKeyUsage = critical, timeStamping`.
- Timestamp token signing-certificate identity: ESSCertIDv2
  (`id-smime-aa-signingCertificateV2`, OID `1.2.840.113549.1.9.16.2.47`),
  hash algorithm SHA-256 — not the legacy ESSCertID v1 (implicit SHA-1)
  attribute.
- `ess_cert_id_chain = yes`: the ESS signing-certificate attribute covers the
  full certificate chain, not just the leaf.
- Token embeds the intermediate certificate but **not** the root; the root is
  supplied out-of-band at verify time via `-CAfile`, and the intermediate is
  additionally supplied via `-untrusted` so verification never depends on
  system trust or embedded-cert content alone.
- Message imprint: SHA-256 of the fixed hex digest below (an arbitrary,
  deterministic value — not derived from any real draw or receipt data).

## Files

| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `root_cert.pem` | Self-signed root CA certificate (public only). |
| `intermediate_cert.pem` | Intermediate CA certificate, signed by the root (public only). |
| `tsa_cert.pem` | TSA leaf certificate, signed by the intermediate (public only). |
| `token.tsr` | DER-encoded RFC3161 TimeStampToken over the fixed message imprint below, signed by the TSA leaf key (which was discarded after signing). |
| `golden_vector.json` | Machine-readable pointer: which file is which, and the exact `-digest` hex value `fixed13_crypto_runtime.py` must pass to `openssl ts -verify` to reproduce this check. |

## Verification command

```
openssl ts -verify \
  -digest 36f3c97ae740a010245de169cc0528e29bccddb6553be59fb0c386f6d1b8bfa7 \
  -in token.tsr -token_in \
  -CAfile root_cert.pem \
  -untrusted intermediate_cert.pem
```

- Passes (`Verification: OK`) under a genuinely capable OpenSSL >=3 backend.
- Fails under LibreSSL (observed on this host's `/usr/bin/openssl`, LibreSSL
  3.3.6) with `ess signing certificate error` — LibreSSL's `ts` implementation
  does not correctly evaluate the ESSCertIDv2/chain attribute this profile
  uses. This is the exact defect `BIGLOTTO_FIXED13_CRYPTO_RUNTIME_CANONICALIZATION_R1`
  closes: the fixed-13 verifier must never silently select an incapable
  backend like this one.

## Validity / provenance

- Generating OpenSSL: `OpenSSL 3.6.3 9 Jun 2026` at `/opt/homebrew/bin/openssl`
  (Homebrew, Apple Silicon).
- Key algorithm: NIST P-256 (`prime256v1`) EC for every certificate in the
  chain.
- `notBefore`: `Sep  2 13:49:22 2026 GMT` (root, intermediate, and leaf were
  all issued in the same generation run).
- `notAfter`: `Aug  9 13:49:22 2126 GMT` (`-days 36500`, ~100 years) for all
  three certificates, so this fixture does not become a wall-clock time bomb.
- TSA policy OID: `1.2.3.4.5.6.7.8.1` (an arbitrary private-use OID, matching
  the convention already used by this project's throwaway test TSAs).

## Regeneration

This fixture is not regenerated by any test or build step; it is static,
committed data. To regenerate it (e.g. if the profile needs to change),
repeat the root -> intermediate -> TSA-leaf generation using a known-capable
OpenSSL >=3 binary (never the system LibreSSL), issue a token over a freshly
chosen fixed digest with `ess_cert_id_alg = sha256` and `ess_cert_id_chain =
yes` in the `ts` config, confirm the resulting attribute is
`id-smime-aa-signingCertificateV2` (not the legacy v1 OID
`1.2.840.113549.1.9.16.2.12`) via `openssl asn1parse`, update
`golden_vector.json` with the new digest, and delete every private key used
in the process before committing.
